# AMZ Explorer

> AMZX is a high-throughput, carbon-negative Layer-1 blockchain engineered by Amazonic One for environmental real-world asset tokenization (REDD+ carbon credits), forest preservation verification, and ESG compliance.

AMZ Explorer (`https://amzexplorer.com`) is the primary interface for inspecting blocks, transactions, smart contracts, decentralized accounts, validator nodes, and on-chain tokens.

## Core Network Specifications

- **Network Name**: AMZX Mainnet (Amazonic One)
- **Native Utility Coin**: AMZ (1 AMZ = 10^8 atomic units)
- **Flagship Carbon Asset**: amz1 (Asset ID: 7JuwpAgKpQDuorg5xX8AFbhRMMgrCfbwUgdktxypkYHz - High Integrity REDD+ Carbon Credit Token)
- **High Precision Token**: AUSDTW (18 decimal places token)
- **Consensus Algorithm**: Fair Leased Proof-of-Stake (LPoS) with Waves-NG microblocks
- **Block Time**: ~6 seconds average
- **Chain ID**: 65 (Character: 'A')
- **Address Encodings**: Native Base58 (starts with 3...) and EVM Equivalence (0x...)
- **Smart Contract Engine**: Ride (Functional, deterministic, formal verification) + EVM Transaction support

## Key Web Pages & Explorer Sections

- [Home Dashboard](https://amzexplorer.com/): Real-time network telemetry, block height, transactions/s, consensus voting, and live feed.
- [Blocks Explorer](https://amzexplorer.com/blocks): Chronological ledger of all blocks, generator validators, sizes, fees, and signatures.
- [Transactions Stream](https://amzexplorer.com/transactions): Comprehensive transaction stream with filters for transfers, dApp invocations, asset creation, and executions.
- [Smart Contracts & dApps](https://amzexplorer.com/contracts): Directory of audited on-chain smart contracts with callable function interfaces and Ride bytecode inspection.
- [Network & Validator Nodes](https://amzexplorer.com/nodes): Global telemetry of active peers, block producers, protocol features, and consensus health.
- [Rich List & Balances Ranking](https://amzexplorer.com/ranking): On-chain ranking of top token and asset holders.
- [Official Carbon Asset amz1](https://amzexplorer.com/asset/7JuwpAgKpQDuorg5xX8AFbhRMMgrCfbwUgdktxypkYHz): REDD+ Carbon Credits verification and trade desk.
- [Official Wrapped Token AUSDTW](https://amzexplorer.com/asset/7i8QogaFNfDWJi93yreUYgtJ12ZFLiPFdJaC1WLoD7tU): 18-decimal precision token details.
- [Address Converter](https://amzexplorer.com/address-converter): Bidirectional converter between Base58 and EVM (0x MetaMask) representations.

## Official Encrypted Network Endpoints

- **Public Node API**: `https://nodes.amzexplorer.com/`
- **Matcher DEX API**: `https://matcher.amzexplorer.com`
- **MetaMask JSON-RPC**: `https://rpc.amzexplorer.com` (Chain ID 65)
- **AMZX Data Service**: `https://data-service.amzexplorer.com`
- **gRPC Control / DEX**: `https://grpc-dex.amzexplorer.com` (WSS/GRPCS:443)
- **gRPC Updates**: `https://grpc-updates.amzexplorer.com` (GRPCS:443)
- **FullExplorer Web UI**: `https://fullexplorer.amzexplorer.com`

## Sitemaps & Structured Indices

- [Sitemap Index](https://amzexplorer.com/sitemap.xml): Index of all blockchain objects (blocks, transactions, addresses, tokens).
- [Main Pages Sitemap](https://amzexplorer.com/sitemap-main.xml): Core explorer routes.
- [Blocks Sitemap](https://amzexplorer.com/sitemap-blocks.xml): Indexed block heights.
- [Transactions Sitemap](https://amzexplorer.com/sitemap-transactions.xml): Indexed transaction IDs.
- [Addresses Sitemap](https://amzexplorer.com/sitemap-addresses.xml): Indexed accounts and contracts.
- [Assets Sitemap](https://amzexplorer.com/sitemap-assets.xml): Native and tokenized assets.
